title: Graph Visualizations in Prompts for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.12938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study when and how multimodal input improves knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) in large vision--language models. Using a controlled evaluation over 1,500 WebQSP and CWQ questions and six VLMs within a fixed KGQA pipeline, we compare text-only prompting against text-plus-graph visualization at the per-question level and analyze performance changes as a function of reasoning complexity, model size, and image layout. Adding a graph image yields an average gain of 1.85 F1 points, driven by strong precision improvements on low-complexity questions (+4.65 F1). Mixed-effects and regression analyses show that these multimodal gains do not depend strongly on model scale, but are highly sensitive to graph layout: image-only settings sharply degrade performance, hierarchical Graphviz layouts outperform less organized renderings, and decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements. translated_title: 面向知识图谱问答的提示图可视化方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了多模态输入何时以及如何改善大型视觉-语言模型中的知识图谱问答（KGQA）。通过对1,500个WebQSP和CWQ问题以及六个视觉语言模型在固定KGQA流程中进行受控评估，我们在逐问题层面比较了纯文本提示与文本加图可视化，并分析了性能变化与推理复杂度、模型规模和图像布局之间的关系。添加图图像平均带来1.85个F1点的提升，这主要由低复杂度问题上显著的精确率改进所驱动（+4.65 F1）。混合效应和回归分析表明，这些多模态收益并不强烈依赖于模型规模，但对图布局高度敏感：仅图像设置会急剧降低性能，层次化的Graphviz布局优于组织性较差的渲染方式，而将大型子图分解为分离的路径则产生最大的改进。
tldr: 该研究发现向提示中添加图可视化可使知识图谱问答平均提升1.85个F1点，且收益对图布局方式高度敏感，其中将大型子图分解为分离路径的布局带来的改进最大。
en_tdlr: Adding graph visualizations to prompts improves KGQA by an average of 1.85 F1 points, with gains highly sensitive to graph layout—decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements.
